description: A sharded `e2e` line whose shard count is a number rather than the size of the matrix. The workflow runs the suites on six machines and the six are the whole suite only while the denominator is `${{ strategy.job-total }}`; typed out as `1/8` beside a matrix of six it is a second copy of a number, and the copies disagree the first time somebody adds or removes a shard. What the disagreement looks like is a green run over tests that never ran — the configuration still declares three engines, points 1-3 still pass, and every job is green.

shardsNotFromMatrix: run: scripts/nx-verdict npx nx affected --shard=${{ matrix.shard }}/8 -t e2e
